summary.text: J.R. Riggins is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 59 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He faces Democrat Laurie Longtine in the general election.

paragraphs.text: J.R. Riggins was born in Kadoka, South Dakota, and graduated from Kadoka High School; Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a project coordinator.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he met his wife in Casper, Wyoming, that he had worked more than 40 years in the natural gas industry, and that he had been active in the Natrona County Republican Party for more than 15 years, including three years as its state committeeman.
Riggins assumed office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Kevin O'Hearn.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Minerals, Business and Economic Development Committee and the House Revenue Committee, as well as the matching joint committees.
In the 2024 survey he listed energy, property taxes and constitutional rights as his main campaign messages and property tax reform as a policy interest.
